prompt: How many times has the Turing Award been given to multiple winners in the same year?
answer:
The Turing Award has been given to multiple winners in the same year **18 times**.

Those years are: **1975, 1976, 1983, 1986, 1993, 1994, 2001, 2002, 2004, 2007, 2012, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2024, and 2025**.
